pages.description: Furina thinks in Inazuma City in this printable coloring page, sitting on a wooden bench with one finger beneath her chin and a small floating creature nearby. Tiled buildings, a torii gate, and a blossoming tree frame the street. Clear outlines separate the larger structures from the finer flowers and clothing details on this coloring sheet.
